title: Nakheel awards contract worth over AED 1.4 billion to deliver 176 villas on Palm Jebel Ali
summary: Ginco General Contracting appointed to deliver 128 Beach and 48 Coral Villas across Fronds A, B, C and D

contentHtml:
Nakheel, a member of Dubai Holding Real Estate, has unveiled a limited release of 44 beachfront villas from its Beach & Coral Collections, spanning 10 distinct architectural designs on Frond F at Palm Jebel Ali. The release represents one of the final opportunities to own a new beachfront villa on the destination’s fronds. Image courtesy: Nakheel

Ginco General Contracting appointed to deliver 128 Beach and 48 Coral Villas across Fronds A, B, C and D

Press Release

  • Construction is expected to take 24 months from commencement of works

Dubai, UAE – Nakheel, a member of Dubai Holding Real Estate, has awarded Ginco General Contracting LLC a main construction contract worth over AED 1.4 billion to deliver 176 villas across four fronds of Palm Jebel Ali, advancing the island’s residential development. 

The contract covers 128 Beach Villas and 48 Coral Villas on Fronds A, B, C and D. Ginco’s scope includes civil, structural and architectural works, mechanical, electrical and plumbing installations, interior fit-outs and external works, with construction expected to take 24 months from commencement of works.

Khalid Al Malik, Chief Executive Officer of Dubai Holding Real Estate, said: “Palm Jebel Ali is a defining destination in Dubai’s coastal growth, and this award brings a further 176 homes to the island. We have a responsibility to create connected, enduring communities that enhance quality of life for residents. Our continued partnership with Ginco supports that responsibility as Palm Jebel Ali takes shape.”

Gheyath Mohammad Gheyath, Founder and Chairman of Ginco General Contracting, said: “This appointment extends our partnership with Nakheel on Palm Jebel Ali. Our teams will bring together civil construction, building services and interior fit-out expertise to deliver the 176 villas to Nakheel’s specifications. Coordinating these disciplines will be central to maintaining quality throughout the construction programme.”

The villas will combine spacious interiors with beach access and views across the Arabian Gulf. The award follows the unveiling of 44 beachfront villas from the Beach and Coral Collections on Frond F, marking further progress across Palm Jebel Ali’s residential neighbourhoods.

Palm Jebel Ali comprises seven islands and 16 fronds, with more than 120 kilometres of coastline and over 90 kilometres of beachfront. Located in Dubai’s southern growth corridor, the development supports the objectives of the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan and Dubai Economic Agenda D33.

About Dubai Holding Real Estate

Dubai Holding Real Estate is the region’s leading integrated master developer within Dubai Holding’s diversified portfolio. With over 30 years of collective development experience, it combines the heritage and innovation of Nakheel, Meraas and Dubai Properties to shape Dubai's urban landscape and coastline through iconic destinations that reinforce the emirate's status as a global hub for real estate investment.

Its portfolio is home to nearly 1.6 million residents across Dubai’s most sought-after locations, delivering value through master planning, development, strategic land sales and asset management, in alignment with the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan to support sustainable, long-term growth.

Nakheel delivers visionary waterfront landmarks and master-planned communities, including Palm Jumeirah and the forthcoming Palm Jebel Ali, designed to meet Dubai’s future urban and population needs. Nakheel also incorporates Meydan’s prestigious communities, such as Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City and District One.

Meraas creates uniquely design-led destinations that blend architecture, creativity, and lifestyle, including the Bvlgari Residences, Bluewaters, Central Park at City Walk, Port de La Mer, The Acres, Cherrywoods and Villa Amalfi.

Dubai Properties specialises in family-focused communities that emphasise accessibility and top-tier amenities, with landmark developments including Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), Business Bay, and Dubailand.

Each development is designed for enduring appeal and strong market fundamentals, combining quality, sustainable infrastructure and community-focused amenities to create long-term value for residents, partners and investors.

Dubai Holding is a diversified global investment company with investments in more than 30 countries and a combined workforce of more than 45,000 people. Established in 2004, Dubai Holding reaches millions of Dubai residents and visitors through its extensive portfolio of over AED 500 billion worth of assets that support the diversification and sustainable growth of Dubai’s economy across 10 key sectors, including real estate, hospitality, entertainment, retail, media and investments.
